            for k in range(len(r1)):
                node = r1[k]
                demand = demands[node]
                # remove node cost change
                # affected edges: prev-node and node-next, where prev is depot if k==0, next is depot if k==end
                prev = depot if k == 0 else r1[k - 1]
                nxt = depot if k == len(r1) - 1 else r1[k + 1]
                old_remove = matrix[prev][node] + matrix[node][nxt]

                # For each target route and insertion position
                for rj in range(len(routes)):
                    if rj == ri:
                        continue
                    r2 = routes[rj]
                    if not r2:
                        continue
                    load2 = loads[rj]
                    if load2 + demand > capacity:
                        continue
                    # insertion between positions p-1 and p (p ranges 0..len(r2))
                    # When p==0: prev=depot, nxt=r2[0]
                    # When p==len: prev=r2[-1], nxt=depot
                    for p in range(len(r2) + 1):
                        ins_prev = depot if p == 0 else r2[p - 1]
                        ins_nxt = depot if p == len(r2) else r2[p]
                        old_ins = matrix[ins_prev][ins_nxt]
                        new_ins = matrix[ins_prev][node] + matrix[node][ins_nxt]

                        delta = (new_ins - old_ins) + (old_remove * 1)  # wrong sign if not careful
                        # Let's compute properly:
                        # New total boundary change for removal: old_remove replaced with matrix[prev][nxt]
                        # delta_remove = matrix[prev][nxt] - old_remove
                        delta_remove = matrix[prev][nxt] - old_remove
                        # New insertion delta: new_ins - old_ins
                        delta_ins = new_ins - old_ins
                        delta = delta_remove + delta_ins

                        if delta < best_delta:
                            best_delta = delta
                            best_move = (ri, k, rj, p)

        if best_move is not None and best_delta < 0:
            ri, k, rj, p = best_move
            r1 = routes[ri]
            node = r1[k]
            # remove node k
            r1_new = r1[:k] + r1[k + 1:]
            if not r1_new:
                # empty route removed (will be filtered)
                routes.pop(ri)
                # adjust rj index if needed
                if rj > ri:
                    rj -= 1
            else:
                routes[ri] = r1_new
                # rj unchanged
            # insert into target
            r2 = routes[rj]
            r2_new = r2[:p] + [node] + r2[p:]
            routes[rj] = r2_new
            # keep going
            changed = True

    # Ensure no empty routes
    final_routes = []
    for r in routes:
        if r:
            # final sanity: capacity
            if route_load(r) <= capacity:
                final_routes.append(r)
            else:
                # fallback: keep feasible by splitting deterministically
                split = []
                cur = []
                load = 0
                for n in r:
                    if load + demands[n] <= capacity:
                        cur.append(n)
                        load += demands[n]
                    else:
                        split.append(cur)
                        cur = [n]
                        load = demands[n]
                if cur:
                    split.append(cur)
                for sr in split:
                    if sr and route_load(sr) <= capacity:
                        final_routes.append(sr)

    return final_routes
